audit_items.proof_trace: Cap issuance is gated by `mint_cap` being `public(package)` (Move VM-enforced, no external caller possible), so the only external entry point is `mint_new_whitelist` which requires `&AdminCap`. The liquidation permission bit (bit 2) is set exclusively through `update_permission` (whitelist.move:53-76), which also requires `&AdminCap`. Runtime enforcement via `ensure_has_permission` (app.move:159-170) checks both whitelist membership and the bit at every liquidation call site, and the test `liquidator_not_whitelisted` confirms a cap at permission=0 correctly aborts.
